same_machine_capture: The exact original packet files and supplemental private records were copied into an owner-restricted local capture and compared byte for byte. The private verifier then checked 128 original members, 13 path and 12 Git-header substitutions, 23 original Git proofs and 12 supplemental files against the public stage and original temporary inputs.
public_qualification: The public check verifies stored and decoded public identities, tree links and qualified commit/leaf crosswalks. It cannot verify the redacted original bytes or the six original Git commit IDs without the restricted inputs. Captured copies and the verifier run do not establish independent-machine custody or historical source-read credit.
prototype_qualification: An earlier public verifier prototype used the wrong stored-versus-decoded form for one gzip Git leaf and failed; VERIFIER-CORRECTION.json preserves the failure and the separately identified successor. No evidence bytes changed in that failure.
scope: The XPBD source reconciliation and attribution addendum remain delegated observations pending central reconciliation. No implementation, product execution, lens closure or unique-finding count follows.
